The "augment or replace" question perhaps deserves a bit more nuance. It seems to me that it's possible to have "a reduced number of people with highly augmented jobs". Farming is the obvious example. Despite populations growing and the demand for food increasing, farming is done by fewer people operating much more powerful machines. So it seems that if an industry is to buck that trend, it has to have a lot of capacity for further growth.
